import os
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
import lightgbm as lgb

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

def main():
    print("Checking input directory...")
    INPUT_DIR = "./input"
    
    # Verify all required files exist
    required_files = ["ru_train.csv", "ru_test_2.csv", "ru_sample_submission_2.csv"]
    existing_files = [f for f in required_files if os.path.exists(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, f))]
    
    if len(existing_files) != len(required_files):
        print(f"ERROR: Missing files. Found: {existing_files}, Expected: {required_files}")
        return
    
    print("Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "ru_train.csv"))
    test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "ru_test_2.csv"))
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "ru_sample_submission_2.csv"))
    
    print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
    print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")
    
    # Feature engineering
    def add_features(df):
        df["char_count"] = df["before"].fillna("").str.len().astype(int)
        df["word_count"] = df["before"].fillna("").apply(lambda x: len(x.split()) if isinstance(x, str) else 1).astype(int)
        return df
    
    train_df = add_features(train_df)
    test_df = add_features(test_df)
    
    # Encode class column from training data
    le_class = None
    train_df = train_df.copy()
    test_df = test_df.copy()
    
    # Only encode 'class' for training since it's missing in test
    class_counts = train_df["class"].value_counts()
    print(f"Class distribution: {len(class_counts)} unique classes")
    
    # Map class values to integers for training features
    class_to_int = {cls: i for i, cls in enumerate(class_counts.index.tolist())}
    train_df["class_idx"] = train_df["class"].map(class_to_int)
    test_df["class_idx"] = test_df.apply(lambda x: 0, axis=1).astype(int)  # Default to 0 for test
    
    # Create character n-gram features
    char_vocab = {}
    for text in train_df["before"].dropna():
        for c in text.lower():
            if c not in char_vocab:
                char_vocab[c] = len(char_vocab)
    
    def get_char_embedding(text):
        embedding = []
        text = str(text).lower()
        for c in text:
            embedding.append(char_vocab.get(c, -1))
        return embedding
    
    X_train_chars = np.array([get_char_embedding(t) for t in train_df["before"]])
    X_test_chars = np.array([get_char_embedding(t) for t in test_df["before"]])
    
    # Create target mapping for many-to-one classification per token
    output_counts = train_df["after"].value_counts()
    print(f"Unique outputs: {output_counts.nunique()}")
    
    # Sample top N common outputs to reduce label space
    top_n = min(50000, output_counts.nunique())
    sorted_outputs = output_counts.head(top_n).index.tolist()
    output_to_id = {o: i for i, o in enumerate(sorted_outputs)}
    unknown_class = top_n
    total_classes = top_n + 1
    
    def encode_output(o):
        return output_to_id.get(str(o), unknown_class)
    
    y_train_enc = train_df["after"].apply(encode_output).values.astype(int)
    
    # Combine features
    def combine_features(X, class_col="class_idx"):
        return np.hstack([X, df[[class_col, "char_count", "word_count"]].values])
    
    X_train_full = np.hstack([X_train_chars, train_df[["class_idx", "char_count", "word_count"]].values])
    X_test_full = np.hstack([X_test_chars, test_df[["class_idx", "char_count", "word_count"]].values])
    
    # Proper train/validation split
    n_train = len(train_df)
    indices = np.arange(n_train)
    np.random.seed(42)
    np.random.shuffle(indices)
    
    val_split = 0.1
    val_size = int(n_train * val_split)
    val_indices = indices[:val_size]
    train_indices = indices[val_size:]
    
    X_train = X_train_full[train_indices]
    y_train = y_train_enc[train_indices]
    X_val = X_train_full[val_indices]
    y_val = y_train_enc[val_indices]
    
    print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train)}, Validation samples: {len(X_val)}")
    
    # Train LightGBM model
    params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": total_classes,
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42
    }
    
    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train, feature_name=['F'+str(i) for i in range(len(X_train[0]))])
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data, feature_name=['F'+str(i) for i in range(len(X_val[0]))])
    
    print("Training model...")
    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=200,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, first_metric_only=True)]
    )
    
    best_iter = model.best_iteration
    print(f"Best iteration: {best_iter}")
    
    # Evaluate on validation set (Genuine hold-out)
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    val_pred_ids = np.argmax(val_pred, axis=1)
    
    # Decode predictions
    val_preds_str = [sorted_outputs[p] if p < len(sorted_outputs) else "" for p in val_pred_ids]
    
    # Compute sequence accuracy on validation
    correct = sum(1 for a, b in zip(y_val, val_preds_str) if a == sorted_outputs[b] if b < len(sorted_outputs) else False)
    total_val = len(y_val)
    
    # Better validation: map encoded IDs back to strings for comparison
    correct_count = 0
    true_labels_str = [sorted_outputs[y] if y < len(sorted_outputs) else "" for y in y_val]
    
    for pred_id, true_out in zip(val_pred_ids, true_labels_str):
        pred_out = sorted_outputs[pred_id] if pred_id < len(sorted_outputs) else ""
        if pred_out == true_out:
            correct_count += 1
    
    val_accuracy = correct_count / total_val if total_val > 0 else 0.0
    print(f"Validation sequence accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")
    
    # Generate final submission on TEST DATA
    print("\nGenerating submission...")
    test_pred = model.predict(X_test_full, num_iteration=best_iter)
    test_pred_ids = np.argmax(test_pred, axis=1)
    
    test_predictions = [sorted_outputs[p] if p < len(sorted_outputs) else "" for p in test_pred_ids]
    
    # Create submission dataframe with proper ID format
    test_df_copy = test_df.copy()
    test_df_copy["id"] = test_df_copy.apply(lambda r: f"{r['sentence_id']}_{r['token_id']}", axis=1)
    test_df_copy["after"] = test_predictions
    
    # Save to submission directory
    sub_path = os.path.join("./submission", "submission.csv")
    test_df_copy[["id", "after"]].to_csv(sub_path, index=False)
    
    print(f"Submission saved to {sub_path}")
    
    # Report accuracy metric
    print(f"\nFinal validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
